reviewPolicy: Sources are curated and recommendations are source-grounded paraphrases. Records remain ai_extracted until a clinician reviews them.

document.title: An Update on Management of Adult Patients with Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome: An Official American Thoracic Society Clinical Practice Guideline

recommendations.text: Use lung-protective ventilation with tidal volumes of 4-8 mL/kg predicted body weight and keep plateau pressure below 30 cm H2O in adults with ARDS.
Consider systemic corticosteroids for adults with ARDS after assessing contraindications and individual risks.

document.title: Global Strategy for Asthma Management and Prevention, 2026

recommendations.text: Use an inhaled-corticosteroid-containing regimen for adults and adolescents with asthma rather than treating with a short-acting beta2-agonist alone.
When suitable, use low-dose ICS-formoterol as the preferred reliever strategy because it reduces severe exacerbation risk compared with a SABA reliever.

document.title: Cardiovascular Disease and Risk Management: Standards of Care in Diabetes-2026

recommendations.text: For type 2 diabetes with established cardiovascular disease or high cardiovascular risk, include an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 receptor agonist with demonstrated cardiovascular benefit as clinically appropriate.
recommendations.population: People with type 2 diabetes and established or high cardiovascular risk
recommendations.intervention: SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 receptor agonist with cardiovascular benefit

document.title: 2026 Guideline for the Early Management of Patients With Acute Ischemic Stroke

recommendations.text: Use either alteplase or tenecteplase for eligible patients receiving intravenous thrombolysis within the 4.5-hour treatment window.
recommendations.population: Eligible patients with acute ischemic stroke

recommendations.text: Do not delay endovascular thrombectomy after thrombolysis to wait for clinical improvement in an otherwise eligible patient.

document.title: 2019 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and management of acute pulmonary embolism
document.sourceBody: European Society of Cardiology/European Respiratory Society

recommendations.text: Base diagnostic testing for suspected pulmonary embolism on validated clinical pre-test probability, using D-dimer testing and imaging in the appropriate sequence.
recommendations.population: Patients with suspected acute pulmonary embolism
recommendations.intervention: Risk-adapted D-dimer testing and diagnostic imaging

document.title: 2024 ESC Guidelines for the management of elevated blood pressure and hypertension

recommendations.text: For most adults receiving antihypertensive treatment, aim for systolic blood pressure of 120-129 mm Hg when tolerated and individualize the target when treatment is poorly tolerated.

document.title: 2025 ACC/AHA/ACEP/NAEMSP/SCAI Guideline for the Management of Patients With Acute Coronary Syndromes
document.sourceBody: American College of Cardiology/American Heart Association

recommendations.text: Use aspirin plus an oral P2Y12 inhibitor for at least 12 months as the default after acute coronary syndrome when bleeding risk is not high.
recommendations.population: Patients with acute coronary syndrome without high bleeding risk

recommendations.text: Prefer ticagrelor or prasugrel over clopidogrel for patients with ACS undergoing PCI when there is no contraindication.
recommendations.population: Patients with acute coronary syndrome undergoing PCI

document.title: 2024 ESC Guidelines for the management of chronic coronary syndromes

recommendations.text: Use invasive coronary angiography when obstructive disease is very likely, symptoms remain severe despite guideline-directed therapy, angina occurs at low exertion, or event risk is high.
recommendations.population: Patients with suspected or established chronic coronary syndrome

document.title: 2025 ESC/EACTS Guidelines for the management of valvular heart disease
document.sourceBody: European Society of Cardiology/European Association for Cardio-Thoracic Surgery

recommendations.text: Use a Heart Team assessment to select transcatheter or surgical aortic valve replacement, considering age, life expectancy, comorbidity, anatomy, access, patient preference, and likely future procedures.
recommendations.population: Patients with severe aortic stenosis being considered for valve replacement
recommendations.intervention: Heart Team selection of TAVI or surgical valve replacement

document.title: Implementing an Antibiotic Stewardship Program: Guidelines by IDSA and SHEA
document.sourceBody: Infectious Diseases Society of America/Society for Healthcare Epidemiology of America

recommendations.text: Implement preauthorization, prospective audit with feedback, or both as core interventions in an antibiotic stewardship programme.
recommendations.intervention: Preauthorization and prospective audit with feedback

document.title: IDSA 2018 Clinical Practice Guideline Update for Seasonal Influenza

recommendations.text: Start antiviral treatment promptly for people hospitalized with influenza, those with severe or progressive illness, and outpatients at high risk of complications.
recommendations.population: Patients hospitalized with influenza or at increased risk of complications

recommendations.text: For otherwise healthy ambulatory patients with uncomplicated influenza, use five days of oral oseltamivir or inhaled zanamivir, or one intravenous dose of peramivir.
recommendations.population: Otherwise healthy ambulatory patients with uncomplicated influenza
